activities.title: Recall & explain

activities.answer: A satisfactory response defines Essay practice: technology and society, explains its main dimensions, makes at least one accurate distinction or causal link, and connects it to the relevant UPSC syllabus. Compare your response with the assigned source and correct gaps.
